question: Should the project adopt `esp_openclaw_node_register_scope()` plus `ESP_OPENCLAW_NODE_MAX_SCOPES` as the public scope-advertisement contract, after the signed-payload mismatch is repaired?
rationale: This introduces new public API and configuration surface; the supplied discussion does not show a maintainer decision on the permanent API, capacity semantics, or compatibility commitment.

options.title: Accept a bounded public scope API
options.body: Keep the API and configuration, but require exact signing/serialization semantics, boundary tests, and real device-to-gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Retain internal scope support but defer the public registration API and Kconfig setting until the required external contract is defined.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Close or pause this implementation until a maintainer sponsors a documented scope model for ESP nodes.

recommendation.title: Accept a bounded public scope API
recommendation.body: Keep the API and configuration, but require exact signing/serialization semantics, boundary tests, and real device-to-gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main feature owner could be attributed from the available history snapshot.
